description: This file is a server-side route handler for a SvelteKit-based frontend, responsible for loading and processing invoice list data with filters, pagination, and sorting. It interacts with a Django backend API to fetch invoice data, transforms the response for frontend consumption, and handles error cases.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Main server load function that extracts URL parameters, constructs API query, fetches invoice data from Django backend, transforms it, and returns it for frontend rendering.
